entities.name: MUL1 (Q969V5)
observations: Human MUL1 is an outer mitochondrial membrane E3 ubiquitin ligase and proposed SUMO E3; query sequence matches at 99.7% identity over 79.8% query coverage.
Reported roles include mitochondrial fission, regulation of AKT1 and TP53 degradation, and modulation of antiviral innate immunity through STING1 and RIG-I.
Annotated localization includes mitochondrial outer membrane, mitochondria, and peroxisomes; mitochondria-derived vesicle transport to peroxisomes is reported.

entities.name: Mitochondrial fission
observations: MUL1 is annotated as promoting mitochondrial fragmentation/fission, potentially through negative regulation of MFN1 and MFN2.

entities.name: Protein ubiquitination
observations: MUL1 is annotated for E3 ubiquitin ligase activity and protein ubiquitination, including reported regulation of AKT1 and cytoplasmic TP53.

entities.name: Antiviral innate immunity
observations: MUL1 is reported to ubiquitinate STING1 to promote type I interferon production and to modulate RIG-I-dependent antiviral responses.
